Inside the network

Its last decision. The same network is written out four times in the stylesheet, once for each of its moves.

Trained with numpy on all 2,097 positions where O is to move, to pick a move minimax rates best. Checked against all 489 ways a game can go when you play every possible move: it never loses. Digit recognizer · Source on GitHub.
